title: ElevenViewsBridge Trusted Callers v1
description: The who allowlist for the signed IPC layer (ELE-3160). Only a connection whose verified code signature matches one of these entries is accepted. Identity is read from the peer's audit token, never from the request body.

requireExplicitAllowlist.description: When true, a caller must appear in `callers` even if its signature satisfies the platform designated requirement.

teamId.description: Apple Developer Team ID the caller must be signed with.

signingIdentifier.description: Exact code-signing identifier the caller must present.

allowedCapabilities.description: Capability ids this caller may invoke; omitted/empty means any registry capability (still subject to scope + approval).
